caption: The drawing depicts two wooden hand tools against a plain, lightly beige background. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown, mimicking the grain and texture of wood. The object on the right is a T-handle auger, shown vertically. It has a horizontal cylindrical handle with rounded ends, attached at the center to a long, straight shaft. The shaft terminates at the bottom with a spiral-shaped auger bit. To the left, there is a detailed side view of the T-handle, showing its contoured shape with a central grip section slightly thicker than the tapered ends. There is small, neatly written text at the lower left corner that reads "SCALE 1/4 TO 1," and in the lower right corner, the artist’s name, "HARRY G. ABERDEEN," is written in capital letters. The composition is simple and uncluttered, with the objects clearly separated and well-defined on the blank background.
title: Bishop Hill: Auger
